headline: Approved minutes, bills, police invoices, and a $200 donation in memory of Arthur Kahn
summary: The board approved the 2-24-26 meeting minutes, bills and checks for Section 8, MRVP and Revolving Fund registers for January and February 2026, and payment to the Malden Police Department for five invoices. The board also reviewed capital project invoices and change orders for several properties and approved a $200 donation to the Malden DAV in memory of former Commissioner Arthur Kahn. All votes were unanimous roll call votes.
decisions: Approved the 2-24-26 meeting minutes, unanimous (Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh, Karin H. Nystrom; Nays: None)

Approved bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP and Revolving Fund Register for January 2026, unanimous (Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, Frank M. Molis, Karin H. Nystrom; Nays: None)

Approved bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP and Revolving Fund Register for February 2026, unanimous (Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, Frank M. Molis, Karin H. Nystrom; Nays: None)

Approved and authorized payment of $6,073.02 to the Malden Police Department with cost paid by the AMP's served, unanimous (Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh, Karin Nystrom; Nays: None)
Approved and authorized a $200.00 donation to the Malden DAV in memory of Arthur Kahn, unanimous (Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh, Karin Nystrom; Nays: None)
